ideal_profile_text:
Interested in Marketing and committed to building a long-term career in the Marketing industry
University students graduating in 2026 or professionals with less than 1 year of work experience
Strong academic background: GPA 3.0+ on a 4.0 scale or 7+ on a 10-point scale
Proficient English, written and spoken
Familiarity with Excel / Google Sheets and basic data or analytics tools
Problem Solving — our Top 1 priority

You figure out what actually needs to be solved, break it into manageable parts, use data instead of assumptions to test your thinking, and come back with a clear recommendation — plus the reasoning to back it up.

 Growth mindset, Resilience & Extreme Ownership

You learn fast and you don’t break under feedback. You fix it and come back better. And you own the outcome from end to end

 Communication, Teamwork & Influence

Clear in writing and in speaking, in both Vietnamese and English. You adjust how you communicate for the audience. You get things done by being reliable and easy to work with.

 Digital & AI

You already use AI daily and you know where it’s confidently wrong. You’re comfortable reading and working with data.

Good To Have

Leadership roles in student organizations, or strong results in business case competitions. 
Internship exposure in consulting, agency, e-commerce, tech or startup. 
Familiarity with Excel / Google Sheets and basic data or analytics tools

Mindset

Problem-solving: Approaches challenges with structured thinking. Doesn’t wait to be told the answer — builds hypotheses, tests them, and moves forward.
AI-first: Actively uses AI tools to work smarter, faster, and better. Sees AI as a competitive advantage, not just a feature.
Can-do attitude: Embraces ambiguity and high standards. Takes ownership even when the path isn’t clear. Finds a way.
